analysis: The only changed hunk in docs/reference/configuration.md (head lines ~621-625, outside the two supplied text units) adds documentation of an overlapped weight-hash read path. A reader thread stays one 4 MiB chunk (WeightHasher.uncachedChunkBytes) ahead of SHA-256 in a second page-aligned buffer (OverlappedFileDigest). This is documentation only. It describes a performance change to weight verification (A-004, T-012, T-027) and gives no sign of changed hash semantics, fallback behavior, or fail-open behavior. I could not review the corresponding Swift implementation (WeightHasher, OverlappedFileDigest), so I cannot confirm it hashes the same bytes as before, handles short reads or I/O errors without producing a wrong digest, or avoids a race between the reader and hasher threads. That is a remaining integration question for any pass that has the source. The supplied units are the unchanged surrounding config reference (GLM qualification, add-on hold, sandbox CLI, endpoint resumption, prefix cache, worker qualification). They were examined for consistency with the threat model (TB-011, TB-012, TB-013, T-041, T-053, T-059 to T-061). They show no new or changed attack surface, and the documented controls such as exact-1 opt-ins, owner-only files and the non-forwarded env vars are consistent with the threat-model descriptions. No findings are reported.
